title: RoleConfirmRequest
description: The input of role.confirm: the pending grant a second administrator confirms, and the reason. This tutorial's own schema: the specification names no operation that changes people or roles (step 43b's README).

grant.description: A pending grant's address, such as dsor://org_456/grant/grt_…, as role.grant answered it.

reason.description: Why, in the administrator's own words, for the people who read the log.
